func save(_ x: Int) async -> Int { x }
func use(_ x: Int) {}

// CASE awaited_local_function expect=fire
func h1(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    func step() async { _ = await save(item) }
    await step()
  }
}

// CASE task_group_per_pass expect=fire
func h2(_ groups: [[Int]]) async {
  for group in groups {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { g in
      for x in group { g.addTask { await save(x) } }
    }
  }
}

// CASE enumerated expect=fire
func h3(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for (i, item) in items.enumerated() {
    use(await save(item + i))
  }
}

// CASE while_index expect=fire
func h4(_ items: [Int]) async {
  var i = 0
  while i < items.count {
    use(await save(items[i]))
    i += 1
  }
}

// CASE where_clause expect=fire
func h5(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items where item > 0 {
    use(await save(item))
  }
}

// CASE async_let_in_loop expect=fire
func h6(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    async let a = save(item)
    use(await a)
  }
}
